metadata.name: Ecodesign for Svelte
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for Svelte: narrow reactive statements, stores unsubscribed, static rendering where possible.

reactivite.name: Svelte — reactivity
reactivite.description: A reactive statement re-runs whenever anything it touches changes (RGESN Frontend).

rules.title: Store subscribed without teardown
rules.description: A manual store subscription outlives the component that made it unless something unsubscribes. The auto-subscription with $ does that for you and is usually what was meant.
rules.recommendation: Use the $store auto-subscription, or keep the returned function and call it in onDestroy.
rules.note: One onDestroy or unsubscribe anywhere in the file silences the rule. Where several manual subscriptions coexist, check that each is torn down.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-SVELTE-003 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.

rules.title: Broad reactive statement
rules.description: A reactive block that recomputes a large derived value re-runs whenever any of its dependencies moves, including the ones that do not affect the result.
rules.recommendation: Keep the statement to the data it needs, and split a wide one into several narrow ones so each re-runs only for its own inputs.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-SVELTE-001 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.
